display.purpose: Hero headline only; 2rem on phones, 2.6rem from sm. Two lines at 1280/1440 desktop, three at 390px by design (owner-editable copy is not shortened).

headline.purpose: Public section headings; page intros step to 2.25rem from sm; admin page titles 600 at 1.5rem.

title.purpose: Sub-section headings, step titles, request panel title.

body.purpose: Running copy in ink; secondary in muted.

label.purpose: Field labels and legends, sentence case; badges at 12px.

numeral.purpose: Tabular shift lengths and references; references widen to 0.05em tracking.

shadows.name: raise
shadows.purpose: Request wizard panel, request status card, admin sign-in card, active admin nav item.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Hero request starter panel and confirmation dialogs.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Background, border, color, and 1px press transform on buttons and controls.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animations and transitions collapse under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Header CTAs appear; mobile action bar hides.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Hero two-column; desktop nav; admin sidebar.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single teal action in any group: Find a Caregiver, Submit, Save.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: var(--radius-control); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-weight: 600; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 15px; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; cursor: pointer; height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; font-size: 16px; background: var(--color-teal-600); color: #fff; border: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(15 34 55 / 0.08); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-teal-700); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-teal-600); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Bordered paper button; always used for Call and WhatsApp.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: var(--radius-control); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-weight: 600; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 15px; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; cursor: pointer; background: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-navy-900); border: 1px solid var(--color-line-strong); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--color-teal-600); color: var(--color-teal-700); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-teal-600); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis teal text action with a tint on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: var(--radius-control); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-weight: 600; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 15px; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; color: var(--color-teal-700); border: none; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-teal-50); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-teal-600); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action; always confirmed in a dialog.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: var(--radius-control); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-weight: 600; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 15px; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; cursor: pointer; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 14px; background: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-rose-700); border: 1px solid rgb(163 39 31 / 0.3); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--color-rose-50); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-teal-600); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Label above, 44px control, teal focus, optional/required marked in the label.
components.html: We use this only when we call you.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-field-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-navy-900); } .ds-field-opt { font-weight: 400; color: var(--color-muted); } .ds-input { height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-control); border: 1px solid var(--color-line-strong); background: var(--color-paper); font-size: 15px; color: var(--color-navy-950); caret-color: var(--color-teal-600); transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgb(82 101 122 / 0.8); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgb(30 58 87 / 0.4); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-teal-600); outline: 2px solid rgb(44 110 106 / 0.3); outline-offset: 0; } .ds-input[aria-invalid=true] { border-color: var(--color-rose-700); } .ds-field-hint { margin: 0; font-size: 12px; color: var(--color-muted); }

components.name: Shift Choice
components.description: Signature: the two permitted shift lengths as identical side-by-side radio faces.
components.html: Shift length
components.css: .ds-shift { border: 0; margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-shift-legend { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-navy-900); } .ds-shift-grid { margin-top: 8px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; } .ds-shift-face { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--color-line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--color-paper); padding: 12px 16px; transition: border-color 150ms, background-color 150ms; } .ds-shift-face input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 1px; height: 1px; } .ds-shift-face:hover { border-color: var(--color-teal-600); } .ds-shift-face:has(input:checked) { border-color: var(--color-teal-600); background: var(--color-teal-50); } .ds-shift-face:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 2px solid var(--color-teal-600); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-shift-num { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: var(--color-navy-900); } .ds-shift-unit { margin-left: 4px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-muted); letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-shift-desc { margin-top: 2px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.375; color: var(--color-muted); } .ds-shift-dot { position: absolute; right: 12px; top: 12px; width: 16px; height: 16px; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line-strong); background: var(--color-paper); } .ds-shift-face:has(input:checked) .ds-shift-dot { border: 5px solid var(--color-teal-600); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Flat paper container with hairline border; header row divided by a hairline.
components.html:
Customer details

Who we call and where care happens.

Content

components.name: Request Panel
components.description: The lifted, actionable panel: hero request starter (Float).
components.html:
Find a caregiver

Takes about three minutes. We call you before anything is arranged.
components.css: .ds-request { border-radius: var(--radius-panel); border: 1px solid var(--color-line); background: var(--color-paper); padding: 24px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-float); font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-request-title { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-navy-900); } .ds-request-sub { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--color-muted); }

components.name: Status Badges
components.description: Pill badges with inset ring; tones map to state (green only for confirmed/positive).
components.html: New Contacted Matching Confirmed Cancelled Completed

components.name: Public Header

components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; height: 72px; padding: 0 24px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(217 227 226 / 0.8); font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-mono { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--color-teal-600); color: #fff; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; } .ds-brand-name { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: var(--color-navy-900); } .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav a { padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-ink); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current=page] { color: var(--color-teal-700); } .ds-header-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-quiet, .ds-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-control); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-quiet { color: var(--color-muted); } .ds-quiet:hover { background: var(--color-mist); color: var(--color-navy-900); } .ds-cta { background: var(--color-teal-600); color: #fff; } .ds-cta:hover { background: var(--color-teal-700); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible, .ds-quiet:focus-visible, .ds-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-teal-600); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
This is the category standard for home care, executed with more care than the category usually gets. A worried family should meet a quiet, well-ordered front desk: white ground, cool neutral fields, navy words, and one muted teal that marks everything you can act on. Nothing performs. There are no stock nurse photographs, no icon-tile card rows, and no invented trust numbers. Trust comes from plain language, a working request form in the first viewport, and visible honesty about what is and is not promised.

Density is generous on the public site and compact on the admin. Both share the same tokens. The public site is a Persuade surface built from wide bands (white, then mist, then white) inside a 72rem column. The admin is an Operate surface: a mist sidebar, white panels, tabular figures, and status badges. Depth is almost entirely hairlines and tonal fields. Shadow appears only where something is lifted to be acted on: the request starter, the request wizard, a dialog.

The world is light only, pinned by the brief (white and neutral grounds, `color-scheme: light`). Figtree is the single family. Hierarchy comes from weight, size, and navy against ink, never from a second face.
keyCharacteristics: White and cool mist grounds, navy headings, ink body, muted teal for action, selection, and progress
Subtle green reserved for confirmed or positive state
One sans family (Figtree) with tabular numerals for references, dates, rupees, and shift lengths
Hairline borders, 14px panels, 10px controls, and pill-shaped badges and chips
Soft navy-tinted shadow only on lifted, actionable surfaces
12 and 24 hours presented as identical, side-by-side equals wherever shift appears

rules.name: The Teal Means Act Rule
rules.body: Teal marks what can be acted on, what is selected, and where you are in a sequence, plus the small wayfinding marks that travel with them (step and shift numerals, the area pin, the monogram tile, info tints). The only large teal field is the closing call-to-action band.

rules.name: The Earned Green Rule
rules.body: Leaf green appears only for confirmed or positive state: a verified caregiver, a confirmed assignment, a saved form, a completed check. Never use it for decoration or as a second accent.

rules.name: The Light Only Rule
rules.body: The system is light theme only (`color-scheme: light`, theme-color white). No dark-mode variants are designed or implied.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Figtree is the only typeface. Make contrast through weight and navy against ink, never through a second family.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: References, dates, rupee amounts, counts, and shift lengths always set in tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, headings, and buttons are sentence case at normal tracking. There are no uppercase labels and no eyebrow lines above headings.

rules.name: The Request In Reach Rule
rules.body: On every public viewport, the real request action is visible without scrolling: the request panel in the desktop hero, the bottom action bar on phones.

rules.name: The Lifted Means Actionable Rule
rules.body: Shadow is never decoration. A surface gets Raise or Float only if it is a form, a dialog, or the current location. Content panels, cards, and tables stay flat with a hairline.

dos: Do use teal-600 for the single primary action in any group, and secondary (bordered paper) for call and WhatsApp.
Do show 12 and 24 hours as equal, side-by-side faces whenever shift is chosen or explained.
Do set every reference, date, rupee amount, and count in tabular numerals.
Do keep panels at 14px and controls at 10px, with 1px hairline borders.
Do keep the request action in reach: the hero request panel on desktop, the fixed bottom action bar on phones.
Do let the owner-editable hero headline wrap naturally (two lines at desktop, three at 390px) rather than shortening copy.
Do use Phosphor icons (regular weight, fill weight for active or confirmed) at 16 to 24px, always `aria-hidden` beside a text label.
Do make review captures in Chromium with `--font-render-hinting=none`. Linux hinting produces false letter-gap artifacts in Figtree.
donts: Don't use stock photographs of people presented as bureau staff, icon-tile card rows, or invented ratings, counts, or testimonials.
Don't use leaf green for anything except confirmed or positive state.
Don't add a second typeface, uppercase labels, or eyebrow lines above headings.
Don't put Raise or Float shadows on content cards. Shadow is for forms, dialogs, and current location only.
Don't use heavy gradients. The only gradient is the hero's gentle mist-to-paper wash.
Don't design a dark theme. The system is light only.
